description: Machine-readable remediation guidance for mail-store. Never capture raw message bodies, recipient content, credentials, DKIM private material, or stored chunk bytes in diagnostics.

entries.whatFailed: RBE durable package storage is unavailable or a storage operation failed
entries.fix: Approve the storage capability, reactivate the exact installed mail package, and inspect the lower-level RBE storage diagnostic. Do not bypass RBE with direct filesystem access.

entries.whatFailed: Committed mail storage failed integrity or manifest validation
entries.fix: Stop using the stored message. Preserve only sanitized ids/hashes for diagnostics, repair or restore the package-storage object set from an authoritative copy, then verify every chunk SHA-256 before making the message visible again.

entries.whatFailed: Message committed successfully but its folder index pointer was not written
entries.fix: Do not store or deliver the message again. Call mail-store repair_index(id) to recreate the folder pointer from the committed manifest.

entries.whatFailed: An immutable mail storage id already exists
entries.fix: Load the existing committed message if this is an idempotent retry, otherwise generate a new unique storage/delivery id. Never overwrite an existing committed id.

entries.whatFailed: A committed message is missing a required chunk, metadata object, or commit manifest
entries.fix: Treat the store as incomplete/corrupt and quarantine the message id. Restore from the original SMTP/provider source or another authoritative copy; do not infer missing bytes.

entries.whatFailed: Message was made invisible/uncommitted but orphan cleanup was incomplete
entries.fix: The message is already logically deleted. Run bounded orphan cleanup/GC later; do not recreate the manifest or folder pointer merely to delete leftover chunks.
